show.description:
A billionaire loses his memory after a passionate night… and marries the wrong sister by mistake.
Years later, the real girl unknowingly falls in love with him while he hides his true identity as a poor bodyguard. But when the truth about that night comes out, love turns into the deadliest betrayal.
